name: MoselyMap_1733
title: Moseley Map-1733
description: Georeferenced map of Edward Moseley's "A new and correct map of the Province of North Carolina." Map clipped specifically to the project area to tailor the map. The map includes the names of landowners, rivers, saw mills, points of interest, cities, ferries, ports, and the Cape Fear Harbour.
snippet: Georeferenced map of Edward Moseley's "A new and correct map of the Province of North Carolina." Map clipped specifically to the project area. Points were referenced where they follow the map's geography rather than the actual georeferenced location.
